### temporalio/temporal (temporalio/admin-tools)

### [`v1.32.2`](https://redirect.github.com/temporalio/temporal/releases/tag/v1.32.2)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/temporalio/temporal/compare/v1.32.1...v1.32.2)

##### What's Changed

- Fix security vulnerabilities for 1.32 minor release by [@​yycptt](https://redirect.github.com/yycptt) in [#​12831](https://redirect.github.com/temporalio/temporal/pull/12831)
- \[release/v1.32.x] Bump auto-scaled-workers to v0.2.1-1.32.0.158.0 by [@​gcristea-temporal](https://redirect.github.com/gcristea-temporal) in [#​12849](https://redirect.github.com/temporalio/temporal/pull/12849)
- Fix sticky queue stats zeroed out by [@​rkannan82](https://redirect.github.com/rkannan82) in [#​11527](https://redirect.github.com/temporalio/temporal/pull/11527)
- Fix a race condition that can leave a poll to not get cancelled during shutdown by [@​rkannan82](https://redirect.github.com/rkannan82) in [#​11841](https://redirect.github.com/temporalio/temporal/pull/11841)
- Fix priority backlog acknowledgement after expired tasks by [@​cbsandeep10](https://redirect.github.com/cbsandeep10) in [#​12595](https://redirect.github.com/temporalio/temporal/pull/12595)
- Small fixes to backlog count tracking in fair backlog manager by [@​dnr](https://redirect.github.com/dnr) in [#​12566](https://redirect.github.com/temporalio/temporal/pull/12566)

##### Potential Breaking Change

- `ValidateWorkerDeploymentVersionComputeConfig` now requires Write access to the namespace. The API has persistent side-effects inconsistent with read-only access, so this requirement is aligned with the API bahavior. Please refer to [#​12843](https://redirect.github.com/temporalio/temporal/pull/12843) for details.

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/compare/v1.32.1...v1.32.2>
